title: Final Helmholtz Free Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for Helmholtz free energy F must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Final Work Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The work done by the system W must be accurately calculated and presented.

title: Use of Ideal Gas Law
description: Important Criteria: The application of the ideal gas law pV = NRT in the derivation must be correctly utilized.

title: Entropy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of entropy S using the correct expressions must be shown.

title: Isothermal Process Understanding
description: Important Criteria: The understanding of the isothermal nature of the process must be clearly stated.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units used in calculations should be consistent and correctly converted where necessary.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: Consideration of limiting cases or special scenarios should be included to enhance the solution.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign errors in the work calculation or free energy derivation must be avoided.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any missing factors in the expressions for work or free energy must be identified.
